description: Listing 39 (Watercolour Dinosaurs Panorama) — two 4:5 Meta feed interior variants: s1 = empty Scandi preschool bedroom in muted sage and dusty blue; s2 = Japandi preschool bedroom in soft sand with a four-year-old boy sitting on the rug from behind.

kit.name: Birch toddler bed, sage and dusty blue
kit.subject: a bright Scandinavian bedroom for a child aged 3 to 5, with a low solid birch toddler bed and a birch book ledge
kit.room: A bright airy room with wide pale oak floorboards and white skirting boards.
kit.floor: On a rectangular flat-weave oat-and-sage wool rug lie three small carved wooden dinosaur figurines and an open hardcover picture book.
kit.side_wall: a low solid birch toddler bed 140 by 70 cm under 40 cm high neatly made with dusty blue washed linen bedding and two small sage-green and oat cotton pillows, a small solid oak bedside cube with a matte cream ceramic night light beside it, and a low birch book ledge holding three illustrated children's books
kit.light: Warm morning sunbeams from a window on the {side} lie in soft patches across the oak floor and rug.
kit.palette: muted sage, dusty blue, pale birch, oat and warm white
kit.items: birch toddler bed, oak bedside cube, ceramic night light, birch book ledge, wool rug, wooden dinosaur figurines, picture book and architecture
kit.life_pose: {person} stands on the rug with {her} back to the camera, {her} face turned away from the camera so no facial detail is visible.
kit.toy: three small carved wooden dinosaur figurines and an open hardcover picture book

kit.name: Oak toddler bed, sand linen and boy on rug
kit.subject: a calm Japandi bedroom for a child aged 3 to 5, with a low solid oak toddler bed and a wooden toy bench
kit.room: A bright airy room with wide warm oak floorboards and white skirting boards.
kit.floor: On a round flat-weave cream cotton rug lie wooden building blocks and small carved wooden dinosaur toys.
kit.side_wall: a low solid oak toddler bed 140 by 70 cm under 40 cm high neatly made with warm sand linen bedding and a dusty blue cotton cushion, and a low wooden toy bench beside it holding two stacked wooden puzzle boxes
kit.light: Soft afternoon window light from the {side} casts gentle natural shadows across the oak floor and rug.
kit.palette: soft sand, pale oak, cream, muted sage and dusty slate blue
kit.items: oak toddler bed, wooden toy bench, wooden puzzle boxes, round cotton rug, wooden building blocks, wooden dinosaur toys and architecture
kit.life_pose: {person} sits on the rug in the middle of the floor about two metres from the mural wall, facing the mural with {her} back to the camera, {her} face turned away from the camera so no facial detail is visible, arranging the small wooden dinosaur toys on the rug
kit.life_action: slowly arranges the small wooden dinosaur toys on the rug
kit.toy: wooden building blocks and small carved wooden dinosaur toys
